fields.metadata.description: Terms of service for Northwind Software Limited.
fields.metadata.title: Terms of Service | Northwind

nodes.text: These terms govern your use of the Northwind platform. By creating an account you agree to them.
The standard plan costs 480 per user per year, charged annually in advance. We may change our pricing on 30 days notice before your renewal date.
Invoices are payable within 30 days of issue. Late payment may result in suspension of the service until the overdue amount is settled.
Our refund policy allows a full refund if you cancel within 14 days of your first payment. After that period fees are non-refundable.
You may cancel your subscription at any time by giving 30 days written notice. We may terminate this agreement if you materially breach these terms. No refunds are given on cancellation.
Your subscription renews automatically for a further twelve months unless you cancel before the renewal date.
Our total liability under this agreement shall not exceed 10,000 or the fees paid in the preceding twelve months, whichever is lower.
The service is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. We disclaim all implied warranties including fitness for a particular purpose.
You grant us a non-exclusive licence to host and process your content solely to provide the service. All intellectual property rights in the platform remain ours.
Prohibited conduct includes scraping the service, reselling access without our consent. We may suspend your account for breach of these terms.
This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales and the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
Any dispute arising under these terms shall be resolved by binding arbitration in London.
Northwind Software Limited was founded in 2011 and employs 400 people across three offices. Our support team is available on weekdays.
